sk_c28f1461.title: Arrange dried stems in vase
sk_c28f1461.summary: Place stems into a vase to create a finished floral arrangement.

steps.title: Insert first stem
steps.instruction: Insert the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.
steps.why: Place stem into vase to build arrangement.
tips: Push gently to avoid bending the stem.

steps.title: Insert second stem
steps.instruction: Insert the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.
steps.why: Place stem into vase to build arrangement.
tips: Align stem with previous ones for balance.

steps.title: Insert third stem
steps.instruction: Insert the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.
steps.why: Place stem into vase to build arrangement.

steps.title: Insert fourth stem
steps.instruction: Insert the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.
steps.why: Place stem into vase to build arrangement.
tips: Maintain even depth for visual appeal.

steps.title: Insert fifth stem
steps.instruction: Insert the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.
steps.why: Place stem into vase to build arrangement.
tips: Finish arrangement with a focal stem.

sk_3b7c613d.title: Cup Placement and Bottle Check
sk_3b7c613d.summary: Arrange cups correctly and verify bottle condition to maintain an organized work area.

steps.title: Pick up front cup
steps.instruction: Pick up the cup in front of you with both hands.
steps.why: To reposition the cup for later placement.

steps.title: Place cup on right
steps.instruction: Place the cup on your right down with the right hand and straighten it.

steps.title: Pick up left cup
steps.instruction: Pick up the cup on your left with the right hand.

steps.title: Place cup front
steps.instruction: Place the cup in front of you down with the right hand and straighten it.

steps.title: Check bottle
steps.instruction: Lift the bottle on your left, hold it up to inspect, then set it back.
